items.html:
Integrated fixes are ready for final qualification:

  • Plane-port illumination now works with traced T-matrices.
  • Complex transverse wavenumbers retain their values and gradients.
  • Autograd material lists and tuples retain component gradients.
  • Invalid complex plane-wave directions raise consistently, including JAX JIT.

Latest environment: 183 targeted tests passed, across all four frameworks. Older supported framework versions: 258 additional checks passed. Ruff and formatting passed.

All frameworks remain optional; ordinary NumPy calls import none. CPU, first-order reverse-mode limits remain documented. Full-suite qualification belongs to the root agent.

Seven files modified; no staging, commits, pushes, builds or Actions runs.
